title: Florida contractors: DBPR qualifier identity with separate business-contact evidence
hypothesis: A current Florida DBPR construction or electrical license can establish a named Qualifier candidate and licensed-trade context. The actual extract has no phone field, so a separately published business number is required; neither the Qualifier nor that number establishes a confirmed owner or direct owner mobile.
ownerSource: FL DBPR CONSTRUCTIONLICENSE_1.csv and lic08el.csv provide an active, unexpired licensee parsed as a Qualifier candidate, with DBA, class code, and business address context. Qualifier is a license role, not owner confirmation.
phoneSource: The DBPR adapter has no phone column. Recipe D obtains a separately published Maps business contact for the register row's city; it remains a business-contact candidate until match, line-type, live, DNC, dedupe, and independent owner-evidence gates pass.

workflow.label: Florida public-record gate
workflow.detail: Use only the documented public DBPR construction/electrical extracts while their eligible source conditions hold.

workflow.label: Current DBPR qualifier record
workflow.detail: Read a construction or electrical extract row only when primary status is C, secondary status is blank or A, and expiration is in the future.

workflow.label: Hold inactive or incomplete record
workflow.detail: Do not route expired, non-current, secondary-inactive, malformed, or non-person licensee rows as a person candidate.

workflow.label: Qualifier candidate assessment
workflow.detail: Preserve the source title Qualifier and class code. Do not promote a qualifier to owner based only on the license record or DBA.

workflow.label: Published business-contact contrast
workflow.detail: Recipe D discovers contractor listings in register-derived cities and compares a credible business match; the register itself contributes no phone.

workflow.label: Hold absent or weak business match
workflow.detail: Keep the DBPR identity for review, but do not infer a number or person-phone edge from city, DBA, address, or a non-match.

workflow.label: Contact and ownership evidence gates
workflow.detail: Require the existing mobile line-type, live, DNC, suppression/dedupe, and independent owner-evidence checks; a business listing is not owner proof.

workflow.label: Hold business-only or failed contact
workflow.detail: Park office, non-mobile, unreachable, suppressed, shared, or qualifier-only cases.

workflow.label: Deliver supported classification
workflow.detail: Deliver only after every contact and owner-evidence gate passes. No DBPR qualifier alone is an owner-confirmed mobile.

edges.label: status, expiry, or person parse fails
no reliable match or no published contact
all gates and independent owner evidence pass

failures.risk: The outdated brain note says the Florida extract has a phone on file, causing a qualifier identity row to be treated as a direct-contact source.
failures.mitigation: Keep DBPR rows phone-null and label the extract identity-only; require a separately published business contact before any verification branch.

failures.risk: A Qualifier is labelled as the business owner or handset owner.
failures.mitigation: Persist title_code Qualifier and require independent owner evidence before owner labeling or delivery.

failures.risk: A city-level Maps contractor is silently connected to the DBPR qualifier merely because it was bucketed in the same run.
failures.mitigation: Require a credible business match and retain match evidence; city co-location, DBA text, and address similarity alone do not prove a person-phone relationship.

failures.risk: A phoneless DBPR match loses its qualifier provenance when Recipe D buckets it.
failures.mitigation: Keep the matched DBPR candidate linked to the Maps row with explicit match strength and Qualifier provenance, then hold it pending independent ownership evidence.

failures.risk: Mixed construction and electrical records or inactive classes are passed through as a current contractor cohort.
failures.mitigation: Keep the adapter's current-status and future-expiry filters and preserve classCode for an explicit trade filter when a narrower industry is requested.

iterations.hypothesis: The configured Florida DBPR contractor route begins with a qualifier and a phone on file.
iterations.test: Five-case local fixture/code audit of flDbprRecord and Recipe-D bucketing branches on 2026-09-24; no provider calls.
iterations.observed: Current active construction person; current electrical person; expired row; non-current row; and current business-only licensee establish that the parser emits a Qualifier candidate with null phone only for the active person cases. The source comment and returned name row contain no phone assignment.
iterations.change: Correct the workflow to identity-only DBPR intake and require a separately published business contact; do not call a registry qualifier or Maps number an owner contact.

iterations.hypothesis: A phoneless DBPR qualifier can remain connected to a credible Maps business match through Recipe D.
iterations.test: Code audit of bucketStep's phoneless-register branch.
iterations.observed: When a register row has no phone, bucketStep writes it as filtered with drop_reason no_register_phone and marks a matched Maps row as bucket 4. The persisted Maps row does not retain the qualifier identity or match linkage needed for owner evidence.
iterations.change: Propose a provenance-preserving association for a credible phoneless register-to-Maps match, held as Qualifier candidate until independent owner evidence passes.

measurement.result: Five local parser/runtime fixtures covered current construction person, current electrical person, expired, non-current, and business-only licensee branches. Active person rows produce Qualifier identity candidates with no phone; inactive/expired rows are skipped. Code audit only: no source request, contact values, mobile status, reachability, DNC, owner confirmation, or delivery was measured.

cost.basis: Fixture/code audit only; no provider or paid verification call
cost.note: No clean delivered owner contact was measured. The contractor_fl brain estimate has a different, unverified denominator and is not a per-clean cost for this review.

implementation.summary: The FL DBPR adapter correctly emits active Qualifier candidates without phone numbers, while the brain's historical description still says phone on file. Recipe D can obtain Maps business contacts by register city, but its phoneless branch discards the qualifier-to-Maps association, so it cannot support owner evidence from a matched record.

nextMeasurement: Add five synthetic Recipe-D rows: a current FL Qualifier with a credible Maps match, an unmatched qualifier, an expired row, a business-only row, and a shared/office Maps line. Verify that a credible match preserves Qualifier provenance without owner promotion, and that only independent owner evidence plus mobile/live/DNC/dedupe gates can deliver. Then conduct an authorized aggregate source and outcome measurement with separate denominators.
